allow_registration.description: Allow users to register accounts via the client (requires server restart to take full effect).

allowed_users.description: List of pre-created user accounts (admin or limited privilege).

password.description: Password for the account (stored in config — use sparingly).

ban_file.description: Path to the ban list database (SQLite format).

ca_certfile.description: Path to CA certificate for validating client certificates (optional).

cert_required.description: Require clients to present a valid SSL certificate upon connection.

channel_last_default.description: If enabled, newly created channels inherit password protection from their parent.

extra_config.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for advanced or undocumented settings (e.g., 'iceport', 'database').

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Empty = log to stdout (systemd journals).

max_bandwidth.description: Maximum audio bandwidth (in bits per second) allowed per user.

max_channel_depth.description: Maximum depth of channel nesting. 0 = unlimited.

max_users.description: Maximum number of concurrent users allowed on the server.

normalize_names.description: Automatically normalize user names to ASCII and remove illegal characters.

opus_enabled.description: Enable Opus audio codec (required for high-quality, low-latency VoIP).

registration_timeout.description: Minutes after which unactivated user registrations expire (10080 = 7 days).

rtti_enabled.description: Enable Runtime Type Information (RTTI). Required only for legacy compatibility.

server_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the server to. Empty string binds to all interfaces.

server_name.description: Human-readable server name used in welcome messages and UI.

server_password.description: Global password required for all connecting users. Leave empty for no global password.

server_port.description: UDP and TCP port for Mumble server clients to connect.

ssl_certfile.description: Path to the SSL certificate chain (PEM format) for encrypted connections.

ssl_keyfile.description: Path to the SSL private key (PEM format) matching the certificate.

static_channels.description: Pre-create static channels with default properties.

max_users.description: Override per-channel max user limit (if omitted, server default applies).

name.description: Internal channel name (used as key in config).

position.description: Sort position among siblings (lower = higher in list).

superuser_password.description: Password for the superuser (admin) account. Must be set initially to create the admin user.

udptunnel.description: Enable or disable UDP packet logging (for debugging).

web_enabled.description: Enable or disable the built-in web interface (for admin and user management).

web_host.description: Interface to bind the web interface to.

web_path.description: Filesystem path to the web interface assets.

web_port.description: Port for the web interface (set to 0 to disable).

default: Please read our rules in the documentation.
welcome_messages.description: List of messages displayed to users upon connection.

items.description: One line of text shown to users on connect.

worker_threads.description: Number of threads for audio processing. 0 = automatic (recommended).
